_comment: CI-only stylelint config (wired into .github/workflows/ci.yml as the blocking 'stylelint-guard' job). Runs ONLY the BizLMS-DOM-selector guard, which is green across the tree today, so it can block pushes safely. The full .stylelintrc.json (this + the prefers-reduced-motion motion rule) stays the richer LOCAL/dev check — the motion rule currently has ~35 pre-existing violations in _surface-*.scss, so it is intentionally NOT wired to CI until those are remediated (tracked as a follow-up). See docs/DEPRECATION-SCHEDULE.md row 5 + ADR-018.

selector-disallowed-list.message: Don't couple NEW SCSS to BizLMS DOM classes (.costcenter_data / .content_right) — target a Sentientia-owned .ap-admin-* hook instead. See docs/DEPRECATION-SCHEDULE.md row 5 + BIZLMS-MIGRATION-NARRATIVE.md. The legacy usages in dark_mode.scss / custom_media.scss are grandfathered (retired in ADR-018 Wave 2). To opt out for an unavoidable case, prepend: // stylelint-disable-next-line selector-disallowed-list
